title: Navy Henley & Olive Cargo Trousers
prompt: An original young woman with long, light brown hair tucked behind one ear stands against a white backdrop. She wears a fitted navy ribbed henley with a short button placket over a light gray layered tank. Wide olive cargo trousers with drawstring cuffs and side pockets sit under a black belt, and a small silver keychain dangles at one hip. White chunky sneakers complete the look. Her expression is calm. Soft, even studio light. Palette of navy, heather gray, and olive. Relaxed and utilitarian, in the style of a streetwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The olive cargo trousers and layered henley are the defining pieces.
- Keep the keychain as a small, playful detail.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the keychain as a playful detail.
